newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA LEV EDGES UP TO 232 PER DOLLAR AT CLOSE.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA LEV EDGES UP TO 232 PER DOLLAR AT CLOSE.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed near 232 per dollar, a touch firmer than 232.50/233 in morning trade as foreign currency supply slightly topped demand amid calm interbank trade, dealers said.
"Supply outweighed demand for most of the day, preventing a possible sharp lev's fall from previous close due to the longer value date of today's spot-deals," a commercial bank dealer said.
The lev closed at 230.00/80 per dollar on Wednesday.
The current large spread between interest rates on dollar- and lev-denominated investments leaves room for a daily lev's easing by some two levs against the dollar, traders said.
The Bulgarian National Bank's (BNB) central interest rate now is set at a record high 300 percent annually.
The BNB was seen trading in both directions, selling small dollar volumes at around 233 levs, dealers said.
Some traders said the central bank probably bought more dollars today than it sold. BNB officials declined comment. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
